title: Door Stage and the Door Bundle Rate
content:
# Door Stage and the Door Bundle Rate

Window Replacement Contracts. The bundle rate is multiplied by a door-commitment share set by the stage of the paired Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract: a door contract still signed and not yet measured takes the unmeasured-door share of 0.5; a measured door contract takes the measured-door share of 0.8; a door contract that is ordered or further along takes a share of one.

The stage is the door contract's status on record. The share multiplies the bundle rate in full, that is the window series bundle percentage together with every amount added to it, before the rate is applied to the amount the credit is figured on; the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Door contract status | Door-commitment share |
|---|---|
| Signed | 0.5 |
| Measured | 0.8 |
| Ordered, installed or closed | 1 |

## Hypothetical figure

A bundle rate of a hypothetical 2.5% with the door contract measured becomes 2% (2.5% times 0.8).
